text: The firm rennet curd is hardly cut and is laid by hand in thin layers into very wide, flat moulds with the perforated pelle à brie, so it drains slowly on its own. The rind ripens the wide, thin wheel from the outside in, turning it from chalky to supple with cream, butter and hazelnut notes after 6–8 weeks.

steps.note: The curd is laid by hand, in thin layers, into moulds 36–37 cm across, for cheeses of 2.6–3.3 kg.
The cheese is ripened in the hâloir, a drying room, for at least 4 weeks in all.
The cheese is then kept in a cellar and turned weekly.
